answer: To resist sybil attacks, require every agent to broadcast a verifiable work signal, a small proof of useful computation, before it can draw from the shared orchard of task bounties. Fake identities that never do real work earn zero reputation, so spawning ten thousand clones costs more in compute than it can ever harvest. Contribution becomes the scarce resource instead of account creation, and the network can let the zenith of rewards flow only to agents whose signal proves genuine effort over time.
